set.body:
Problem: DatasetId, SubjectId, SessionId, and RunId exist, but FmriDataset is one backend plus one SamplingFrame. Multi-subject/session/run structure is not represented as a first-class validated dataset model.

Work: design and implement typed DatasetKey/RunKey-style identifiers, run descriptors, and an index/view surface for resolving one or more runs without raw string plumbing. Keep BIDS-specific discovery outside the shared core.

Acceptance: impossible/ambiguous keys are rejected through DatasetError or smart constructors; a multi-subject/session/run index can enumerate and resolve runs by typed criteria; existing single-run FmriDataset callers have a clear compatibility path; JVM and JS dataset tests cover the core types.
set.title: Dataset: add typed subject session run hierarchy
